name: Women's Tailoring
shortDescription: Structured blazers, tailored trousers, sheath dresses and power suiting cut for the female form.
fabricNotes: Stretch wool suiting, crepe, structured cotton twill and silk blends for occasion pieces.
highlights: Blazers with princess seams for a true waist fit
Tailored trousers cut to your rise and leg shape
Sheath and wrap dresses built on a fitted block
body: Women's ready-to-wear is built on standardised sizing that rarely matches a real body. We start from your own measurements instead, so the waist actually sits at your waist.
Whether it's a boardroom blazer, a tailored trouser suit or an occasion dress, we build in the darts, seams and closures that off-the-rack skips.
Many clients start with a single blazer and return for a full working wardrobe once they feel the difference.

seo.title: Women's Custom Tailoring
seo.description: Bespoke blazers, tailored trousers and dresses cut to your own measurements at Lipek Fashion.
